110    /**
111     * Return male middle name
112     *
113     * @example 'Иванович'
114     *
115     * @return string Middle name
116     */
117    public function middleNameMale()
118    {
119        return static::randomElement(static::$middleNameMale);
120    }
121
122    /**
123     * Return female middle name
124     *
125     * @example 'Ивановна'
126     *
127     * @return string Middle name
128     */
129    public function middleNameFemale()
130    {
131        return static::randomElement(static::$middleNameFemale);
132    }
133
134    /**
135     * Return middle name for the specified gender.
136     *
137     * @param string|null $gender A gender the middle name should be generated
138     *                            for. If the argument is skipped a random gender will be used.
139     *
140     * @return string Middle name
141     */
142    public function middleName($gender = null)
143    {
144        if ($gender === static::GENDER_MALE) {
145            return $this->middleNameMale();
146        }
147
148        if ($gender === static::GENDER_FEMALE) {
149            return $this->middleNameFemale();
150        }
151
152        return $this->middleName(static::randomElement([
153            static::GENDER_MALE,
154            static::GENDER_FEMALE,
155        ]));
156    }
157
158    /**
159     * Return last name for the specified gender.
160     *
161     * @param string|null $gender A gender of the last name should be generated
162     *                            for. If the argument is skipped a random gender will be used.
163     *
164     * @return string Last name
165     */
166    public function lastName($gender = null)
167    {
168        if (static::GENDER_FEMALE === $gender) {
169            return $this->lastNameFemale();
170        }
171
172        if (static::GENDER_MALE === $gender) {
173            return $this->lastNameMale();
174        }
175
176        return static::randomElement(static::$lastName) . static::randomElement(static::$lastNameSuffix);
177    }
178
179    public function lastNameMale(): string
180    {
181        return static::randomElement(static::$lastName);
182    }
183
184    public function lastNameFemale(): string
185    {
186        return static::randomElement(static::$lastName) . 'а';
187    }
